purpose: recompute the per-cut selection with shifted soft weights, two controls and a slack-stratified table

coverage.cuts: only the 4-leaf cuts that ABC rewrite evaluates
coverage.selection: minimum objective inside each cut only; no cross-cut comparison and no per-node final candidate
coverage.graph: original AIG; levels, required and leaf depths recomputed in this run
coverage.global_note: a lower local root_level is not a global level reduction; proving that needs joint installation, which this step does not run

soft_weights: w_l = exp(-(slack_l - min(slack)) / tau), tau in {0.5,1,2}; not normalised
tie_rule: |a-b| <= 1e-9 * max(1,|a|) for the soft schemes, exact for the integer ones
